source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(cell == row[0] for r in grid for cell in r) == w:
            candidates.append((i, 0))
    for j in range(w):
        col = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and sum(row[j] == col[0] for row in grid) == h:
            candidates.append((j, 1))
    pos, vertical = candidates[0]
    if vertical:
        left = [row[:pos] for row in grid]
        right = [row[pos + 1:] for row in grid]
        left_count = sum(v != 0 for row in left for v in row)
        right_count = sum(v != 0 for row in right for v in row)
        target, mask = (left, right) if left_count < right_count else (right, left)
    else:
        top, bottom = grid[:pos], grid[pos + 1:]
        top_count = sum(v != 0 for row in top for v in row)
        bottom_count = sum(v != 0 for row in bottom for v in row)
        target, mask = (top, bottom) if top_count < bottom_count else (bottom, top)
    return [[2 if value != 0 and mask[i][j] != 0 else 0 for j, value in enumerate(row)]
            for i, row in enumerate(target)]
'''
